The Missing Asar Reminder

Your Asar reminder never arrived today, and I checked carefully before telling you that. The other six reminders all reached you within about a minute of schedule, so this one stands out.

The reminder was due at 14:33, ten minutes before Asar at 14:43. I went through the chat between your French lesson reply at 13:40 and your next message at 15:33, and there is nothing in between. There is no entry for it in the goal record either. Friday's Asar was late but it arrived, and Saturday's and Sunday's came on time, so this is the first one with no trace at all.

There is a second gap I should tell you about, from yesterday. The reading reminder due after Maghrib on Sunday at 18:02 also never appeared in chat, even though the record says it was sent on time. Two gaps in two days is something I want to watch, not a one-off.

I want to be honest about what I do not know yet. I cannot see whether the Asar job itself ran and the message got lost on the way, or whether it never ran at all. Either way, the reminder did not reach you, and that is the part that matters, since the whole point is that it appears before the prayer.

I will be watching tomorrow's Asar at 14:33 closely. If it arrives as it should, I will treat today as a single miss. If it leaves no trace again, I will look into the mechanism itself rather than just noting it.

—Muse
